caption: The video captures a close-up of a sparkler positioned against a uniformly blurred gray background. A pink coated handle rises from the bottom, meeting a dark gray pyrotechnic shaft near the center of the frame. At that junction, a small orange-yellow flame flickers continuously, while the black coating above it remains largely unchanged. Bright sparks appear intermittently, shooting outward in short streaks to the left and right, then fading before new bursts form. Thin wisps of smoke occasionally drift upward from the burning point, softening the flame’s edge. The camera stays steady, keeping the tilted stick centered as the active burn continues without a visible start or finish.
